pages.title: African national parks
pages.extract:
Many of these parks are on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
They can be visited for safaris, to see the African flora and fauna.

pages.title: Alor Archipelago
pages.description: archipelago located at the eastern Lesser Sunda Islands
pages.extract: Alor Archipelago is an island group in Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. Previously well off-the-beaten-path, more and more adventurous travelers are discovering this remote island group. The vast majority of the infrastructure of the archipelago is either based in, or run from  Kalabahi. The key attractions are water-based, including world-class diving and fishing. While diving in the often pristine reefs is getting more popular, the number of divers is still limited by the availabiliy of dive resorts, and the fact that resorts usually don't offer courses for new divers.

pages.title: Chałupy
pages.extract: Chałupy (pronounced Khahwoopi) is a small village and seaside resort in Pomeranian Voivodship in Poland.

pages.title: Djerba
pages.extract: Djerba is an island and a cultural  UNESCO World Heritage Site in south Tunisia with beautiful sandy beaches and beautiful, peaceful and silent countryside. One from the best ecological destinations in the world, this island preserves its traditions and its unique architectural theme.

pages.title: Keyport (Washington)
pages.description: census-designated place in Kitsap County, Washington, United States
pages.extract: Keyport, known as "Torpedo Town USA," is on the Kitsap Peninsula in the Puget Sound of Washington state. It is home to the Naval Undersea Warfare Center, a U.S. Navy depot tasked with ranging and repairing torpedoes.

pages.title: Meridian
pages.description: city in and the county seat of Lauderdale County, Mississippi, United States
pages.extract: Meridian is a city in Mississippi. It was a titan of commerce of sorts during the Reconstruction era and up through the Great Depression, even after General Tecumseh Sherman had torched it, due to its being a hub to five major rail lines and manufacturing during its golden age. It is now a treasure trove for some of the architecture preserved from that period. Meridian is also noted for being the location of the US v. Cecil Price court case, where several Ku Klux Klan members were charged for the abduction and murder of three Civil Rights workers in 1964 in nearby Neshoba County, an event analogously portrayed in the film Mississippi Burning.

pages.extract: Thames is an old gold mining town on the west coast of the Coromandel Peninsula on the North Island of New Zealand. Thames has a rich history and is the great place to start any visit to the Coromandel Pensinsula.

pages.extract: Vigo is a port in Galicia in northwest Spain. It's industrial but has an old town and lots of maritime heritage. In 2024 the population was 295,000.

pages.title: Sports
pages.description: form of event or activity involving competition; series of activities that provides challenges for an individual or team/s of participants
pages.extract:
This topic is mainly about doing sport. See also spectator sports.
A sport is a physical activity, primarily done or watched for recreation. Some sports are also modes of transportation (cycling, hiking, cross country skiing, horse riding etc).

There are several reasons to combine sports with travel.

Travellers might want to build up physical fitness at home, before an arduous journey.
A destination might have favourable weather.
A destination might have favourable nature, or sport facilities.
One destination, typically a low-income country, might provide a sporting experience at a lower cost than another.
Some sports can be illegal or strongly regulated in some countries, while legal in others.
The destination might hold competitions, tours or organized events.
Travellers might want to uphold their exercise habits while travelling.
